definitions.explanation: A humble way to refer to one's own company when speaking or writing to clients, partners, or other external parties. Literally 'small company,' it follows the Japanese convention of self-deprecation in business communication.
Literally, something small denoted by {社|しゃ}: a small company or business, or a small Shinto shrine. Used descriptively rather than as humble self-reference.

examples.japanese: {小社|しょうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ご⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

{小社|しょうしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{品質管理|ひんしつかんり}→品質管理：21220_hinshitsukanri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{細心|さいしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}って→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: At our company, we pay the utmost attention to quality control.

examples.japanese: {小社|しょうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{創業|そうぎょう}→創業：11792_sougyou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{五十年|ごじゅうねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたり、お⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧さま⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|こた}えて→応える：09893_kotaeru⟧まいりました。
examples.english: For over fifty years since its founding, our company has been dedicated to meeting the trust of our customers.

examples.japanese: {小社|しょうしゃ}⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: Although it is a small company, it has unique technology.
There are several small shrines in the town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小社|しょうしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{参拝者|さんぱいしゃ}→参拝者：21620_sanpaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絶|た}えない→絶える：13814_taeru⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even among small local shrines, there are some that always have visitors.

notes:
Compound of {小|しょう} ('small') and ⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧ ('company; shrine'). The humble business sense is the primary modern usage, following the Japanese pattern of using {小|しょう} as a self-deprecating prefix: {小生|しょうせい} ('I,' humble, literary), {小著|しょうちょ} ('my book,' humble).

USAGE:
- Sense 1 (humble 'our company') is used in formal business correspondence, emails to clients, and corporate communications
- More formal than ⟦{弊社|へいしゃ}→弊社：17404_heisha⟧, though both are humble; ⟦{弊社|へいしゃ}→弊社：17404_heisha⟧ is the more common humble term in modern business
- Sense 2 can mean either a small company or a small Shinto shrine, depending on context

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小社|しょうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: our company's products
- {小社|しょうしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: at our company
- {小社|しょうしゃ}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧: from our company
- {小社|しょうしゃ}⟦にて→〜にて：21803_nite⟧: at our company (written)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{弊社|へいしゃ}→弊社：17404_heisha⟧: our company (humble) — the most common humble term for one's own company in modern business
- ⟦{当社|とうしゃ}→当社：22449_tousha⟧: our company (neutral) — a neutral reference to one's company, used in internal documents and presentations
- ⟦{御社|おんしゃ}→御社：17179_onsha⟧/⟦{貴社|きしゃ}→貴社：15664_kisha⟧: your company (respectful) — used to refer to the other party's company in conversation (⟦{御社|おんしゃ}→御社：17179_onsha⟧) or writing (⟦{貴社|きしゃ}→貴社：15664_kisha⟧)
